items.title: Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2022
items.q: we took Dave to meet, you know like an Eastern religious leader like a Baba Muktananda or Baba Hari Dass

ctx.x: I knew there had to be a reason that this thing was in this living room.

Oh you know what? And I never quite — you brought up the question of how did Dave become a Catholic. And it’s a very interesting story. So he’s always been interested in Jesus and all these different religions. There’s times in our lives where Dan, mainly, he was the prime mover like the couple of times we took Dave to meet, you know like an Eastern religious leader like a Baba Muktananda or Baba Hari Dass, or these different people. So yeah, he had an open mind. And you know one of the things I think it was Hari…

Wow. That reminds me of a story both Dave and Iola told me about being in a van like a VW type van driving up to summer camp in Vermont, music camp. And that’s when “God’s Love Made Visible” was written.
